description.narrative: The Project will complete two sub-projects - Chkondideli and Mirtskhulava, unfinished residential complexes in Tbilisi Georgia. The Project aims to address prevailing developmental challenges related to lack of sustainable urban housing in Tbilisi which are affordability, energy efficiency, safety and accessibility.
